title: Sasha Ahmed
description: Sasha's passion for law developed after having been mentored by her high school legal studies teacher.
html:
Sasha Ahmad​

Paralegal​

Sasha is currently studying a Bachelor of Laws at Macquarie University.

During her High School years, Sasha developed a strong passion for law having been mentored by her high school legal studies teacher. After leaving school, Sasha originally pursued a Bachelor of Economics at the University of Technology, Sydney. However, Sasha realised her true calling was in law and transferred into a bachelor of laws in early 2020.
